mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <2.0% over the past year.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) both increasing signal a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to rise when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in their respective periods over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in unemployment rates above 4.0% signals weakening labor market strength, prompting market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns do not turn negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in employment (PAYEMS) above its previous month's level indicates a strengthening labor market, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to rise when PAYEMS increases in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and stable unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) creates a favorable labor market environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous month and UNRATE <4.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns do not rise when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE remains below 4.0% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion characterized by low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <2.0%) and rising demand (GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to rise during periods defined by GDPC1 growth and FEDFUNDS <2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in supply (INDPRO) alongside accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 2.0%) signals reduced inflationary pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS rise in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns do not follow positive when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS rise in the past month.
